summary: There is no law-uniform output-TV continuity modulus in the matrix coefficients under only cap-one product inputs, even inside the exact target and compact finite-fragment extreme class. For A0=diag(1,1,1,0) and Aeps=A0+eps(e1 e4^T+e4 e1^T), both target-valid and ||Aeps-A0||op=eps, choose X1,X2,X3 iid Uniform[0,1] and X4 with density one on two half-length intervals centered at +/-1/eps. Then Law(X^T Aeps X) and Law(X^T A0 X) have total-variation distance at least 1/128 for every 0<eps<=1. This refutes only perturbative small-coefficient/near-span reasoning; it does not refute QFORM. Distant fragment centers must be quotiented as affine translations or aggregated before reciprocal payment.
